pulse.label: Pulse
pulse.purpose: Reach and follows: one idea, one takeaway, one question that drives comments.
use_cases: a pattern or principle in 60 seconds
a hot take on industry news

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.use: Native feed video. Upload the .srt as captions.

platforms.name: Instagram Reels
platforms.use: Reel; choose cover_9x16.jpg as the cover.

platforms.name: X
platforms.use: Native video; non-Premium accounts are limited to about 2 min 20 s.

brief.label: Brief
brief.purpose: Authority: one framework explained properly, with a real example and your opinion.
use_cases: explain a framework (e.g. TOGAF in practice, team topologies)
decision guide (build vs buy, monolith vs microservices)
answer a question CTOs keep asking you
brief.face: Standard intro + outro (reused), optional 1 mid-point @me clip (~48 credits).

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.use: Main upload: thumbnail, .srt captions, chapters in the description.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.use: Full native video (LinkedIn allows up to 10 min). Upload the .srt.

platforms.name: X
platforms.use: Full video needs X Premium; without it post the cut-down clip and link YouTube.

platforms.name: Instagram Reels
platforms.use: Teaser cut-down; 'full version on YouTube' in the caption.

platforms.name: YouTube Shorts
platforms.use: Teaser; set the full video as the Short's related video.

deepdive.label: Deep Dive
deepdive.purpose: Trust and leads: a full playbook or case study a CTO can act on.
use_cases: modernization playbook (e.g. a bank's core platform)
case study with numbers and lessons
operating model / governance that actually works
deepdive.face: Standard intro + outro, a 6-8 s @me opener at each chapter (~48 credits each).

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.use: Main upload: thumbnail, .srt captions, chapters in the description.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.use: Post the strongest clip natively; YouTube link in the first comment.

platforms.name: X
platforms.use: Clip + short thread with the YouTube link.

platforms.name: Instagram Reels
platforms.use: One clip per day across the week.

platforms.name: YouTube Shorts
platforms.use: Clips linked to the full video.

masterclass.label: Masterclass
masterclass.purpose: Flagship and lead magnet: an evergreen, chapter-by-chapter course a CTO would bookmark (also hosted on prakash-tiwari.com).
use_cases: enterprise architecture from zero to board level
AI platform strategy for the enterprise
the CTO's guide to legacy modernization
masterclass.face: Standard intro + outro, a 6-8 s @me opener at each chapter (~48 credits each).

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.use: Main upload: thumbnail, .srt captions, chapters in the description; pin a comment linking prakash-tiwari.com.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.use: One clip per post over two weeks; YouTube link in the first comment.

platforms.name: YouTube Shorts
platforms.use: Clips linked to the full video.
